data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'pistis' meaning faith and 'phos' meaning bright or shining. The name Fai carries the meaning “Faith, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fai usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
